title: fix(hooks): automatic reset hooks fail after the triggering request ends
body:
Fixes https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/146349

## What Problem This Solves

Automatic session-reset hooks can lose delayed tracked work after the triggering request finishes.

## User Impact

Reset handlers can finish delayed effects after requester closure. Failures still log, later handlers still run, and Gateway reservations release. No configuration, public SDK, or caller-authority change is required.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the detached continuation already landed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/144801 at the automatic-reset dispatch boundary. Ordinary independent continuations remain unchanged. The accepted cancellation lifetime, Gateway affinity, admission fences, and capability closures are preserved.

Vasu Bansal's caller repair and tests retain their contributor ancestry; LiuwqGit contributed the shared helper. The contributor integrated its containing main without replaying the earlier webhook restoration. Temporary Code Mode and CI-routing changes are absent from the current diff. This PR now contains only the reset caller and its regressions: production +2/-2 (net zero), tests +179.

## Evidence

Current head: `06af4b53d67b36308ef328e637dd9846ce9ceda7`, integrating main `5cd8e290ab6b75f1f95378e2b3c69c6fe5e6a5ad`. Complete two-file diff SHA-256: `7d328d1cfc8cf9ea536254687bfc49a959bacdca7935e10413168af4ae176b3a`.

- Fresh independent source review and autoreview passed on this head (`scoped-clean`, exit 0, final source identity verified). [Exact-head ClawSweeper review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/146350#issuecomment-5648146380) found no actionable findings or remaining rank-up moves.
- [Exact-head hosted CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34778852511) completed successfully: 146 successful jobs, 17 skipped, including the [required CI gate](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34778852511/job/103785447426). [Workflow Sanity](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34778852485) also passed. Native preparation and merge retain their live-head and freshness checks.
- Independently inspected hosted logs confirm all 67 targeted tests on this head: [32 hook and bundled-memory cases](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34778852511/job/103782503275), including all three new regressions, and [35 admission cases](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34778852511/job/103782505695). The [catalog integration shard](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34778852511/job/103782503195) also passed both immediate and seven-second endpoint cases. All three jobs completed successfully. These are current-head hosted receipts, independently confirming the contributor's focused-test report.
- The [immutable real idle-rollover evidence](https://github.com/VasuBansal7576/openclaw/tree/970168e60f90efa4e3b78e9a898cb74fa4217a2e) exercises actual session initialization, SQLite, hook dispatch, and a real archive subprocess after requester closure, ending with zero roots. The emitter/admission bytes match this head. This is reused boundary proof; it does not claim a fresh full-runtime capture on subsequently changed upstream code. The [baseline comparison](https://github.com/VasuBansal7576/openclaw/tree/00f1704237f41026fca76adfe96598d6e8b5f340/real-idle-rollover) records the closed-scope failure. Bundled memory is an unchanged successful control. No live provider/channel or every third-party plugin is claimed.

<details>
<summary>Retained historical qualification</summary>

The earlier maintainer native command passed 66 tests on an older base, then ended with exit 255 after entering changed gates, before an aggregate result or final digest. Its cause remains unknown. Those tests are prior-base evidence, not qualification of this head. [Testbox infrastructure run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34766479085); assertions ran in the native remote command, not the provisioning Actions job.

The contributor's temporary CI-routing correction preserved Peter Steinberger's credit and was absorbed when https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/147293 reached main. Its [immutable baseline/candidate evidence](https://github.com/VasuBansal7576/openclaw/tree/eacfab28253d3ee3ba51e2941ab9b8a348e10e82/routing-ci-repair) and [prior90a CI success](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/34776519783) remain historical receipts. No PR-owned timeout increase, retry, or assertion weakening is retained.

</details>

The announcement repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/147150 and routing/authority report https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/145865 remain separate. This change makes no claim about other independent-root callers.

Release note: automatic-reset hooks can finish delayed work after the triggering request ends, preserving failure reporting and Gateway drain accounting.
